AI Receptionist for Housecall Pro (2026)

Housecall Pro sells its own AI call answering, but it doesn't publish the price. If you'd rather know the cost up front, a few answering services connect to it. Only one in our directory has a native integration. The rest go through Zapier, and Housecall Pro's Zapier app can only create customers.

← All solutions · Integrations checked Oct 15, 2026 against vendor docs

🧭 Quick decision rules

  • You want call notes logged on the customer record→ Smith.ai. It has the native Housecall Pro integration.
  • You're on the Basic plan→ Housecall Pro's Zapier app needs Essentials or MAX, so use Smith.ai or an answering service that texts you.
  • You want a known monthly price→ Rosie ($49/mo, 250 minutes) or Dialzara ($29/mo, 60 minutes), via Zapier.
  • You'd rather keep everything in one bill→ Ask Housecall Pro about CSR AI, its paid add-on.

🏠 What works with Housecall Pro

Labels show how each tool connects

Smith.ai

Native

Native integration using your Housecall Pro API key: callers are matched to existing or new customer records, and call summaries and bookings are logged in your account. Booking goes through your Housecall Pro online booking link. Each Smith.ai plan includes one free integration.

💵 Free: 25 calls/mo ($3/call after)
Source: docs.smith.ai 1, docs.smith.ai 2
Full review →Visit Smith.ai ↗

Rosie

Via Zapier

Rosie says it connects to Housecall Pro using its Zapier integration and gives a duct-cleaning customer as an example.

💵 Professional $49/mo (250 minutes); Scale $149/mo (1,000 minutes); Growth $299/mo (2,000 minutes)
Source: heyrosie.com
Full review →Visit Rosie ↗

Dialzara

Via Zapier / webhook

Dialzara says it sends service requests to Housecall Pro by email, SMS or webhook, and lists Zapier for Housecall Pro on its blog.

💵 From $29/mo (60 minutes); higher tiers from $99/mo
Source: dialzara.com
Full review →Visit Dialzara ↗

Housecall Pro

Built in (add-on)

Housecall Pro's CSR AI is its own AI call answering. It's a paid add-on and the price isn't published.

💵 Basic $59/mo annually ($79 monthly, 1 user); Essentials $149 ($189, 5 users); MAX from $299 ($329, 8 users).
Source: help.housecallpro.com
Full review →Visit Housecall Pro ↗

⚠️ Housecall Pro's Zapier app has two triggers (New Scheduled Job, New Completed Job) and one action, Create Customer. That means a Zap can add the caller as a customer but can't book the job. Zapier is available on Essentials and MAX. Source: zapier.com 1, help.housecallpro.com 2

Questions people ask

Does Rosie integrate natively with Housecall Pro?No native integration. Rosie connects through Zapier.
What can Zapier do in Housecall Pro?Create a customer. Its triggers are New Scheduled Job and New Completed Job. It can't create a job or estimate from a call.
How much is Housecall Pro CSR AI?Housecall Pro doesn't publish the price. You'll need a quote from them.
